chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, and Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah, who said:
I asked Al-Reza (peace be upon him) about the washing for the day of Friday, so he (peace be upon him) said: 'It is an obligation upon every male and female, whether a slave or free.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on Friday washing in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Rida (AS) explicitly defines the Friday Ghusl as a Wajib (obligatory) act for every Muslim, irrespective of gender or social status, highlighting its universal applicability in Shia jurisprudence. It underscores the spiritual preparation required for the weekly congregational prayer, linking physical purity with communal worship as emphasized in the Imams' teachings.
